title: Industrial robots working in factories surpass 5M worldwide
key_facts: Global stock of operating industrial robots passed 5 million last year, up 9% (International Federation of Robotics)
Global installations rose 11% to more than 600,000 units
China installed 354,000 (+20%), 59% of the world total
US rose 12% to 38,500 and replaced Japan (down 19% to 36,219) in second place
IFR forecasts 655,000 installations this year and 806,000 by 2029
quote_evidence: the global active industrial robot inventory surpassing 5 million last year, according to a report.
The International Federation of Robotics said the operational robot stock rose 9% on an annual basis and global installations jumped 11% to more than 600,000 units.
why_it_matters_hint: China now installs most of the world's new factory robots, and the US has overtaken Japan.
notes: Figures are IFR's; the Tribune article relays them. Report release date not stated.
